compiled_state.title: [sprint-architecture]: Per-branch CI review bypass via DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 has no recovery mechanism -> entire sprint reviewed as monolithic diff
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

During sprint d076-d35e-55db-4843 (the epic that *shipped* the per-branch CI review architecture), the orchestrator used \`DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0\` to commit sub-agent work directly to the session branch instead of dispatching agents into per-story sub-branches. As a result, 22 commits with DSO-Story trailers landed on the session branch without ever creating sub-branch PRs.

The shipped architecture detected this correctly — \`verify-session-provenance.sh\` marks those commits as un-provenanced, and \`ci.yml\`'s narrow integration review unions un-provenanced SHAs into the LLM review scope. So the entire sprint output ended up routed through a single integration review on PR #140. The LLM reviewer hit a ~1095-line diff and produced cycle-3 findings that included 4/4 critical false positives ("file X does not exist" hallucinations against files that demonstrably do exist).

## Reproduce / Conditions

1. \`/dso:sprint <epic>\` runs in ci-pr mode
2. Sub-agents work in worktree-isolated environments but commit directly to the session branch using \`DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0\` (escape hatch documented in CLAUDE.md)
3. Story sub-branches are never created
4. Sprint completes; \`merge-to-main.sh\` opens session->main PR
5. CI runs \`per-branch-review.yml\` (per-story review) on the WHOLE diff because the session branch is effectively the story branch
6. LLM review produces unreliable findings on the oversized diff

## Gap

There is no recovery mechanism to retroactively split bypassed commits into per-story sub-branch PRs after the fact. The shipped architecture *detects* the bypass but cannot *remediate* it.

## Proposed Mechanism

\`plugins/dso/scripts/redistribute-session-commits.sh\`:

- Input: \`--epic <epic-id>\` and optional \`--dry-run\`
- Walks \`git log main..session-HEAD\`, extracts \`DSO-Story:\` trailers
- Groups commits by story-id (auto), surfaces untagged commits for user classification (interactive)
- Preserves merge commits (they represent integration history)
- For each story-id: creates \`story/<epic-id>/<story-id>\` from main, cherry-picks the commits in order, pushes, opens PR with \`base=<session-branch>\`
- Result: per-story PRs each trigger per-branch-review.yml on scoped diffs; the session->main PR's narrow integration review shrinks to only true cross-branch concerns

## Related

- Sprint epic d076-d35e-55db-4843 (closed) shipped detect/route mechanism
- Companion bug: governance for the DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 escape hatch (separate ticket)

comments.body: ADDITIONAL FINDING from manual redistribution attempt on PR #140: Trailer-based partition is insufficient. Commit 6def60b4c2 has 'DSO-Story: 5921 (S3)' trailer but adds resolve-session-branch.sh which is S5's deliverable. Commit 964e7a6279 has 'DSO-Story: 8e8a (S5)' trailer but adds test-check-ruleset-preflight.sh which is S3's test. Parallel sub-agents in a shared session worktree produce commits where the trailer reflects the AGENT's assigned story but the diff CONTENT spans story boundaries. Tool needs file-content-aware partitioning or temporal chunking fallback. See bug detail for design options 1-3.
comments.author: Test
